domain_analysis.notes: All five inputs use kani::any() with no kani::assume() narrowing. Cover statements document boundary exploration. The id parameter is symbolic but not used for slot allocation (builder-driven), which is correct per implementation.

allocation_cases.analysis: lower_repeat calls allocate_slot() twice. With prefix P reserved, slot_count() returns P. First allocation reserves P+1, second reserves P+2. Success requires P+2 <= 65535, i.e., P <= 65533. At P=65534, second allocation fails with value=65535. Harness correctly encodes all cases.

node_fields_analysis.notes: All fields verified against implementation in part_07.rs. RepeatFinish.output is the fresh result slot while RepeatFinish.kind.result is the attempt slot - harness correctly distinguishes these.

unchanged_other_harnesses.ask_harnesses: Unchanged in kani_lower_control.rs - still use id+1 resume assumption which is correct for lower_ask
unchanged_other_harnesses.choose_harnesses: Unchanged - fanout limit tests remain valid
unchanged_other_harnesses.module_registration: kani_lower_control.rs disabled with #[cfg(any())] due to stale Repeat harnesses; new kani_lower_repeat.rs registered with #[cfg(kani)]

unwind_analysis.reasoning: Call graph is linear with no loops: harness -> reserve_slots -> slot_count -> lower_repeat -> allocate_slot (x2) -> slot_count -> reserve_slots. Maximum depth is ~8-9 frames. Unwind 12 provides margin.

limitations: Harness tests lower_repeat in isolation with manual reserve_slots; does not test integration with full workflow compilation
Does not verify runtime behavior of RepeatStart/RepeatAttempt/RepeatFinish nodes - only structural correctness of lowering
Slot count verification relies on builder.slot_count() which is tested indirectly
